chapter: Countess Johnson's band and the Kansas City scene
title: Clubs the Countess band played: Bar la Duc, Movie Chateau, State Line Tavern
summary: They broadcast nightly and played clubs whose tunes they carried over to McShann.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: But in that group that we had, now those tunes that we brought over to McShann Max Hand's, some of them we had been playing with the Countess, see?
And we were broadcasting every night.
Oh. What was the name of the club she's in?
Well, we went to the Bar la Duc first; then we went to the Movie Chateau (phonetic).
And then we opened that State Line Tavern. You probably read about Tommy Douglas being in there. But he did not- please there.
